column1: After asking for a flight to Beirut, you think..."Hey, Sonny, are you out of your ever-lovin' mind??? That's no place to visit right now!"
column2: 問了前往貝魯特的航班後，你心想……「嘿，桑尼，你是不是瘋了？？？現在可不是去那裡的時候！」

column1: Your ticket to Coarsegold will be $195.00, please.
column2: 「前往科斯戈爾德的票價是 195.00 美元。」

column1: I'm sorry Sir. We don't have any flights to that location.
column2: 「抱歉，先生。我們沒有飛往該地點的航班。」

column1: Would you please be more specific, sir?
column2: 「先生，能請你說得更具體一點嗎？」

column1: With what? Good looks?
column2: 用什麼？靠英俊外表嗎？

column1: I'm awfully busy, officer. Would you see the next agent please?
column2: 警官，我非常忙。請去找下一位售票員好嗎？

column1: I'm sorry, sir. The telephone is for our use only.
column2: 「抱歉，先生。這支電話僅供我們使用。」

column1: Would you step around to the side of the counter, officer?
column2: 「警官，請走到櫃檯側邊，好嗎？」

column1: Certainly, officer!
column2: 「當然可以，警官！」

column1: There doesn't seem to be a pay phone. Perhaps one of the ticket agents will let you use their phone.
column2: 這裡似乎沒有公共電話。也許某位售票員會讓你使用他們的電話。

column1: The ticket agent hands you a list of flights and passengers and says, "Here you are, officer."
column2: 售票員遞給你一份航班與旅客名單，說：「給你，警官。」

column1: You carefully look over the list but nothing rings a bell.
column2: 你仔細查看名單，但沒有任何名字引起你的注意。

column1: Carefully scanning the passenger list, a name catches your eye. "Luis Pate."
column2: 你仔細掃視旅客名單，一個名字引起你的注意：「路易斯．佩特。」

column1: You blurt out to the agent, "Luis Pate....that's the jailer's name! Bains is using the jailer's ID!"
column2: 你脫口對售票員說：「路易斯．佩特……那是獄警的名字！班恩斯正在使用獄警的身分證件！」

column1: The destination listed is Houston.
column2: 「名單上的目的地是休士頓。」

column1: The ticket agent advises you that the Houston flight departed approximately 20 minutes ago.
column2: 售票員告訴你，飛往休士頓的航班約在 20 分鐘前起飛。

column1: The agent informs you..."I'm sorry, but there are no more Houston flights today."
column2: 售票員告訴你……「抱歉，今天沒有其他飛往休士頓的航班了。」

column1: However, she continues, "there is a connecting flight to Denver leaving shortly."
column2: 「不過，」她繼續說，「很快會有一班轉機飛往丹佛。」

column1: Yes, sir, the agent says, "we have been given authorization by the Police Department to get both of you onto the connecting flight for Houston."
column2: 「是的，先生，」售票員說，「我們已獲警察局授權，讓你們兩人搭乘前往休士頓的轉機。」

column1: Here are your tickets, gentlemen. The flight will be boarding at Gate 12, up the escalator and to your right.
column2: 「先生們，這是你們的票。航班將在 12 號登機門登機，搭手扶梯上樓後往右走。」

column1: You already have your ticket to Houston.
column2: 你已經有前往休士頓的票。

column1: You trade in your unused ticket to Steelton for a ticket to Houston.
column2: 你把未使用的斯蒂爾頓機票換成休士頓機票。

column1: Your ticket to Houston will be $195.00, please.
column2: 「前往休士頓的票價是 195.00 美元。」

column1: You look at the folding cash in your money clip, and you know beyond the shadow of a doubt that you'll never board that flight for Houston if you have to pay for it yourself.
column2: 你看著錢夾裡的現金，十分確定如果要自己付錢，絕對搭不上那班飛往休士頓的飛機。

column1: Yes, sir, the agent says, "we have been given authorization by the Police Department to get both of you onto the next flight for Steelton."
column2: 「是的，先生，」售票員說，「我們已獲警察局授權，讓你們兩人搭乘下一班前往斯蒂爾頓的航班。」
